abstract: A case of metastatic choriocarcinoma of the kidney is reported. A 34-year-old married woman was referred to our department complaining of gross hematuria, fever and loin pain. Computed tomography revealed a right renal tumor with mixed density and multiple lung metastases. We performed nephrectomy to control refractory hematuria. The histological diagnosis of the tumor was metastatic choriocarcinoma. In young women, with gross hematuria, menstrual irregularity and atypical renal tumor with multiple lung metastases, metastatic choriocarcinoma of the kidney should be suspected.
abstract_ja: 34歳の既婚女性が肉眼的血尿、発熱、腰痛を主訴に当科を紹介受診した。CTで混在濃度を示す右腎腫瘍と多発肺転移を認めた。難治性の血尿を制御するため腎摘除術を施行した。組織学的診断は転移性絨毛癌であった。肉眼的血尿、月経不順、多発肺転移を伴う非定型的な腎腫瘍の若年女性では、腎転移性絨毛癌を疑うべきである。
